chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjal, from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from Uqba ibn Khalid, who said:
I went to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he came out to me, then said: 'O Uqba! These women have kept us from you.'

key_terms.النِّسَاء: Women — referring to the women of the Imam's household
key_terms.شَغَلَتْنَا: Kept us occupied/distracted — used to explain the delay

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say when Uqba ibn Khalid visited him?
ai.summary: Uqba ibn Khalid, a companion of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), narrates that when he visited the Imam, the Imam came out to greet him personally and acknowledged that household affairs — specifically, the demands of women in the household — had delayed him from seeing his visitor sooner. This brief anecdote reflects the domestic life of the Imam and the close bond between him and his companions.
